full_judgment: 2. Plaintiffs case, in short, is that the suit land appertaining C.S Khatian No.308 of Monza of panchuria, P.S , Chatmohar, District- pabna originally belonged to plaintiff No. 1 and Radha Gobinda Das, the predecessor of plaintiff Nos.2 and 3, the two brothers in equal share who prior to partition in 1947 for the cause of communal riot lets this country and took shelter in west Bengal in India and as such the suit property came under the management of the Government of the then East Pakistan under tile provision of East Bengal Evacuee (Administration of immoveable properties) Act of 1951 and they. Without coming back to the country, used to manage the property through Ajahar Ali Akonda under the provision of East Bengal Evacuee Administration of Immoveable properties) Act of 1951: and thereafter Ajahar , All having been in possession of the same land in aforesaid manner for more than 12 years died leaving his sons who are in possession of the suit land on behalf of the plaintiffs and the plaintiffs at the death of Ajahar Ali appointed his son Aftab Hossain as Attorney on their behalf to manage the property by power of Attorney dated 22.12.1960.
